domain_description: Analysis, diagnostics, and optimization of oilfield equipment systems including mud pumps, BOP stacks, fracturing pumps, separators, artificial lift, SCADA, wellhead equipment, coiled tubing, wireline, tank batteries, pipelines, electrical distribution, chemical injection, and safety instrumented systems. Based on API standards, SPE papers, IADC guidelines, and manufacturer specifications.
authority_sources: API RP 11AR (Recommended Practice for Artificial Lift)

engines.name: Mud Pump Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze triplex and duplex mud pump performance, liner sizing, valve maintenance intervals, pulsation dampener design, hydraulic horsepower calculations, and failure mode analysis for drilling fluid circulation systems.
doctrine_topics: triplex pump liner sizing and selection
liner and piston failure mode analysis

golden_queries.question: Size a triplex mud pump for 12 ppg mud at 3000 psi, 400 gpm circulation rate
What is the recommended valve replacement interval for a Gardner Denver PZ-11 pump running 14 ppg weighted mud?
Analyze failure modes for mud pump liners in high-temperature geothermal drilling applications above 350F

engines.name: BOP Stack Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze blowout preventer stack configurations, pressure ratings, testing requirements, and emergency response procedures for well control equipment per API 16A and API RP 53.
doctrine_topics: BOP pressure testing requirements per API RP 53
BOP stack-up for various well profiles

golden_queries.question: Specify a BOP stack configuration for a 15,000 psi HPHT well in the Gulf of Mexico with H2S risk
What are the BOP pressure test requirements before drilling the 13-5/8 inch intermediate casing section?

engines.name: Frac Pump Diagnostics Engine
engines.function: Analyze high-pressure fracturing pump performance, power end and fluid end diagnostics, plunger and packing selection, and maintenance optimization for stimulation operations.

golden_queries.question: Diagnose a fluid end failure on a Quintuplex 2500 HHP frac pump showing pressure fluctuations at 9000 psi treating pressure

engines.name: Separator Optimization Engine
engines.function: Optimize production separator vessel design, sizing, and operating parameters for two-phase and three-phase separation of oil, gas, and water.

golden_queries.question: Size a three-phase horizontal separator for 5000 BOPD, 15 MMSCFD gas, 2000 BWPD, operating at 500 psig and 120F with 35 API oil

engines.name: Artificial Lift Systems Engine
engines.function: Analyze and optimize artificial lift systems including rod pumps, ESPs, gas lift, plunger lift, PCP, and jet pumps per API RP 11AR guidelines.
doctrine_topics: rod string design and failure analysis

golden_queries.question: Select the optimal artificial lift method for a well producing 200 BOPD with 95% water cut, 8000 ft TVD, 3.5 inch tubing, and 15 degree deviation

engines.name: SCADA Monitoring Engine
engines.function: Design and optimize Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition systems for oilfield remote monitoring, alarm management, and production optimization.

golden_queries.question: Design a SCADA architecture for monitoring 200 remote well sites across a 50-mile area in the Permian Basin with cellular connectivity

engines.name: Preventive Maintenance Engine
engines.function: Optimize preventive and predictive maintenance programs for oilfield equipment using reliability-centered maintenance, condition monitoring, and failure analysis.

golden_queries.question: Develop a predictive maintenance program for a fleet of 20 ESP wells using vibration analysis and current monitoring

engines.name: Wellhead Equipment Engine
engines.function: Analyze wellhead and christmas tree equipment selection, pressure ratings, material specifications, and maintenance per API Spec 6A.
doctrine_topics: casing head and tubing head selection
material requirements for sour service (NACE MR0175)

golden_queries.question: Specify wellhead equipment for a 10,000 psi sour gas well with H2S concentration of 15% and CO2 of 8%
